description: 2021 Annual Metrics - National Transit Database is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. Contains metrics describing service consumption and service cost for each public transportation agency, by mode and type of service. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 39 columns, among them Fare Revenues per Total Operating Expense (Recovery Ratio), Total Operating Expenses Questionable, Fare Revenues per Total Operating Expense (Recovery Ratio) Questionable, Source Data:, Any data questionable?, Unlinked Passenger Trips Questionable. The portal shows 2023-01-23 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
